name: Filing package check
summary: Before a filing goes to the attorney for signature, the paralegal gets every item on the firm’s own checklist for that court and judge marked pass or open: caption against the docket, length and format, certificates, exhibits, signature blocks and service. The attorney decides and signs.

sources.title: Fully Powered AI's own rules for legal work prepared for a lawyer: the firm's attorney-approved checklist as the only measure, findings quoted and located rather than judged, no date counted, nothing written for use, and every open point a line for the named attorney to confirm.

sources.contribution: Gathering the court, case number, kind of document and the judge's own requirements first; the judge's and court's requirements ranked above general practice; every caption element held against the docket with no shortened party name; a closing pass over length, certificates, exhibits and the signature block; and asking rather than guessing when a requirement is unclear.
